newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG NEED AWAY WIN TO STAY IN TITLE RACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG NEED AWAY WIN TO STAY IN TITLE RACE.

text.p: Troubled Paris St Germain, trailing leaders Monaco by seven points, will seek a badly needed away win in Lens on Thursday to keep their hopes alive in the French title race.

The off-form Parisians, trying to regain confidence since the humiliating 9-2 aggregate defeat against Juventus in the European Supercup, are looking for their first win in six league matches since their 3-1 victory in Caen last November.
Meanwhile Monaco host lowly Le Havre on Friday and could enlarge their lead to 10 points with 12 matches to play.
Paris, who had to fight hard to qualify for the third round of the French Cup against third division Fecamp last week, will be hoping to rescue their season in the same way as Lens have done.
The northern team, who tumbled from an early top spot to 16th place, are now slowly recovering.
"We are getting better and better but we are far from safe and we need points to leave the relegation zone", Lens coach Slavo Muslin said. "We have no time to lose."
Ousted from the French Cup by champions Auxerre last week, Lens know they have to improve their strike rate if they are to stay in the top flight.
"Recently we had a problem scoring. We missed too many opportunities and that was the reason for our poor results," Muslin said.
They will be cheered by the return of Czech striker Vladimir Smicer, now fully recovered from a broken nose.
"This will be a tough match but we proved in our last outings we deserve to play in a European Cup next year," Lens midfielder Jocelyn Gourvennec said.
Former champions Nantes, in eighth place, face champions Auxerre, three points ahead of them in joint fourth.
"I am confident in the team," Nantes coach Jean-Claude Suaudeau said. "Even when matches are tight the players show a great maturity and that boosts their confidence."
Nantes playmaker Japhet N'Doram of Chad should return after a two month absence through injury.
